These DOCX files are synthetic test fixtures for automated comparison tests.

They must not contain real customer, employee, account, transaction, institution,
or confidential Postbank information. If a fixture is replaced, verify that the new
document is synthetic before committing it to source control.

The Original_Postbank_Test_Letter and Revised_Postbank_Test_Letter pair supports the
29-change ground-truth regression test. The simple and table pairs support focused
API and comparison behaviour tests.
